name: Hannover-Braunschweig
author: pierreggt
description: Fused map of Hannover and Braunschweig, Germany, from Hannover Airport and Braunschweig-Wolfsburg Airport, covering the surrounding Lower Saxony towns and the joined regional rail network. Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022). Real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchor Braunschweig and 28 surrounding satellite municipalities; Hannover itself relies on a POI-density gravity model.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online) for Braunschweig and satellite towns, gravity model for Hannover itself, OSM, Overture Maps
